cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.metaDescription: Learn about how we use cookies on our website, including Google Analytics and other tracking technologies.

whatAreCookies.title: What Are Cookies?
whatAreCookies.description: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device when you visit our website. They help us provide you with a better browsing experience by remembering your preferences and enabling essential website functionality.

howWeUseCookies.title: How We Use Cookies
howWeUseCookies.description: We use cookies to enhance your experience on our website, analyze website traffic, and understand how visitors interact with our site. This helps us improve our services and provide you with more relevant content.

essential.title: Essential Cookies
essential.description: These cookies are necessary for the website to function properly. They enable basic features like page navigation, access to secure areas, and remembering your cookie preferences. These cookies cannot be disabled as they are essential for the site to work.

analytics.title: Analytics Cookies
analytics.description: We use analytics cookies to understand how visitors interact with our website. These cookies help us analyze website traffic, measure the effectiveness of our content, and improve our services.
analytics.googleAnalytics: We specifically use Google Analytics to collect anonymous information about how you use our site, including which pages you visit, how long you spend on each page, and how you found our site.

managingCookies.title: Managing Your Cookie Preferences
managingCookies.description: You have several options for managing cookies on our website:

options.browserSettings: Adjust your browser settings to block or delete cookies
options.cookiePopup: Use our cookie consent popup to accept or decline non-essential cookies
options.thirdPartyTools: Use third-party tools like browser extensions to manage tracking

cookieRetention.title: Cookie Retention
cookieRetention.description: Essential cookies are stored for the duration of your session or until you clear your browser data. Analytics cookies are typically stored for up to 24 months to help us understand long-term usage patterns.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.description: We may update this cookie policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. Please check this page periodically for any updates.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.description: If you have any questions about our use of cookies or this cookie policy, please contact us through our website or forum.
